name: ci-status-snapshot
description: Token-efficient GitLab CI, GitHub Checks, MR, and PR status handling: one-shot snapshots, a silent local watcher that notifies only on state change, and GitLab auto-merge delegation.

interface.shortDescription: CI snapshots with token-free state notifications
interface.longDescription: Check CI, PR, and MR state in one bounded call, classify it as ACTION, WAIT, or DONE, and hand any further waiting to a silent local watcher or provider-side auto-merge instead of polling in model turns.
defaultPrompt: Use $ci-status-snapshot to inspect CI once, keep my Goal active, and delegate any continued polling to the silent local watcher.
Merge this MR when checks pass.
